about_the_game:
Overview

Rest Point offers ten carefully designed scenes - from the nighttime streets of the city to quiet corners of nature. The atmosphere will help you slow down, focus or just addition to free movement, a fully dubbed campaign in English and Czech is included. This gradually connects each location and delivers a short, non-violent story about the search for inner peace, motivation and ways to solve problems. The whole experience is complemented by original music composed exclusively for this game - carefully composed tracks create a unique atmosphere that emphasizes the emotions of each scene. The pace and the way you experience it is completely in your hands.

Detailed Description

Rest Point is an audiovisual experience on the border between a game and an application, created for those who need to slow down, take a breath, or escape the pressures of everyday life. It is not a traditional game – you won’t find any opponents or complex puzzles, although you can play a unique campaign with voice acting. Instead, you choose between calm scenes, each with its own atmosphere and sound environment – from the rustling of the forest to the distant noise of a night-time train station. The music plays a key role in the entire experience. Each track was composed exclusively for Rest Point and can’t be found anywhere else. The music is designed to not disturb, but to naturally accompany your mood – whether you need to focus, relax, or simply experience the present moment.

Key Features

  • 10 unique scenes – divided between daytime and nighttime environments, city and nature

  • Campaign with voice acting – available in both Czech and English

  • Carefully crafted music – original compositions tailored to each scene, not available outside the game

  • Simple controls – designed for a smooth and uninterrupted experience

  • Versatile use – ideal for relaxation, meditation, writing, studying, or quiet observation

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card

short_description: Rest Point is a place of calm in the chaos of today's world. Choose from several locations, immerse yourself in the atmosphere of nature or the city and relax without worry. Listen to original music, ambient sounds like birdsong and enjoy a peaceful moment. Because everyone needs a place to relax.
supported_languages:
English*, Czech*, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support
